M1.rule: smallest batch first; a failed or aborted configuration skips its larger batches; MPS only after M3 passed

M2.when: a batch-32 peak above peak_limit_bytes, swap growth above swap_growth_tolerance_bytes, or a memory abort

order: setup: the synthetic export and the shipped models
M1 (cpu x2, cpu x8, then mps x2 once M3 passed; batch 8, 16, 32)
M2 on MPS (only if its batch 32 does not fit)
M4 with M7 during it (MPS only)
M2 on the CPU (only if the CPU is chosen and its batch 32 does not fit)

recipe.wrappers: every R1 wrapper on, early stopping off

rules.budget: refused before the start above the limits; a measurement whose prior would pass a limit is not started; the run stops once the measured spend passes one
rules.child_deadline: CPU child: remaining CPU-seconds / threads; MPS child: the smaller of remaining GPU-minutes x 60 and remaining CPU-seconds / 2; M4: remaining GPU-minutes x 60, its CPU time watched; parent timeout: deadline + 60 s
